full.en: ORGANIC CHOCOLATE PORRIDGE with raw cacao & chia seeds. Sweetened with coconut palm sugar. Ingredients: OAT bran * (79%), cocoa powder (Theobroma cacao) * (7%), coconut palm sugar (Cocos Nucifera) * (7%), chia seed (Salvia hispanica) * (7%). * organic. Contains naturally present sugars. May contain traces: PEANUTS, MILK, NUTS, SOY BEAN and SESAME. Cooking instructions: add hot water or milk and stir well. Wait for 2 to 3 min and enjoy the meal. Storage: Store in a cool and dry place. Neto weight 350 g. Best before end: see top of the bag. It is recommended not to exceed the dose of 15 g of chia seeds per day!

full.hr: ORGANIC CHOCOLATE PORRIDGE sa sirovim kakaom i chia sjemenkama. Zaslađen šećerom kokosove palme. Način čuvanja: Čuvati na hladnom i suhom mjestu. Neto težina 350 g. Najbolje upotrijebiti prije kraja: vidjeti vrh vrećice. Preporuča se ne prekoračiti dozu od 15 g chia sjemenki dnevno!
full.it: ORGANIC CHOCOLATE PORRIDGE con cacao crudo e semi di chia. Dolcificato con zucchero di palma da cocco. Ingredienti: crusca D’AVENA* (79%), cacao in polvere (Theobroma cacao) * (7%), zucchero di palma da cocco (Cocos Nucifera) * (7%), semi di chia (Salvia hispanica) * (7%). * biologico. Attendere 2 o 3 minuti e gustare il pasto. Conservazione: Conservare in luogo fresco e asciutto. Peso netto 350 g. Da consumarsi preferibilmente entro: vedere la parte superiore della busta. Si raccomanda di non superare la dose di 15 g di semi di chia al giorno! full.hu: ORGANIC CHOCOLATE PORRIDGE nyers kakaóval és aztékzsályamaggal. Kókuszpálma-cukorral édesítve. full.sk: BIO CHOCOLATE PORRIDGE so surovým kakaom a chia semienkami. Sladené kokosovým palmovým cukrom. Počkajte 2 až 3 minúty a vychutnajte si jedlo. Skladovanie: Skladujte na chladnom a suchom mieste. Hmotnosť netto 350 g. Najlepšie pred koncom: pozri hornú časť vrecka. full.pl: ORGANIC CHOCOLATE PORRIDGE z kakao i nasionami chia. Słodzona cukrem kokosowym. full.es: GACHA DE CHOCOLATE ORGÁNICO con cacao crudo y semillas de chía. Endulzado con azúcar de palma de coco. Ingredientes: salvado de AVENA* (79%), cacao en polvo (Theobroma cacao)* (7%), azúcar de palma de coco (Cocos Nucifera)* (7%), semilla de chía (Salvia hispanica) * (7%). *orgánico. full.pt: ORGANIC CHOCOLATE PORRIDGE com sementes de cacau e chia. Adoçado com açúcar de palma de coco. Aguarde 2 a 3 minutos e desfrute da refeição. Armazenamento: Armazenar num local fresco e seco. Peso líquido 350 g. O melhor antes do fim: ver a parte superior do saco. full.nl: ORGANIC CHOCOLATE PORRIDGE met rauwe cacao & chiazaadjes. Gezoet met kokospalmsuiker. Ingrediënten: HAVERZEMELEN* (79%), cacaopoeder (Theobroma cacao) * (7%), kokospalmsuiker (Cocos Nucifera) * (7%), chiazaad (Salvia hispanica) * (7%). * Biologisch. Bevat van nature aanwezige suikers.
